baseline_manifest.contract: P1024/C1024 all pairs; CPU1T; unchanged native modes; changing populations; fresh process per repeat
baseline_manifest.timing: Primary evolve_wall_ms: cold evolution initialization + complete generations + final evaluation; excludes input import and post-search audit/export. process_wall_s includes those costs. Lock waiting excluded.

constraints: No architecture/pipeline changes. CPU1T, native GPU reproduction, fullP1024/C1024, complete cold search. Any semantic candidates require explicit quality evidence, separate from exact candidates. Sum default initial population already solved; cannot use it alone to assess search quality.
